[[File:Tourscan-Star_Tours.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tourscan advertising a tour of [[Praya]]]]
'''Tourscan''' was a video display device used by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency in its [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]] to advertise their various tours.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref> It had multiple video screens displaying images of planets, tour information and weather reports, as well as the [[Public relations droid|PR droid]] that narrated the advertisements, [[Dan Android]].<ref name="CGTST">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1st}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
